summary: Adjusted structured logger file persistence to be opt-in via WALKER_LOG_FILE=true, preserving stderr output, log level filtering, and sensitive-field masking while invoking log rotation before opening walker.log.
notes: WALKER_LOG_FILE must equal true, case-insensitively, before logger creates logs/walker.log.
rotateLogFile(filePath) is called before fs.createWriteStream(filePath, { flags: 'a' }); rotation errors are ignored by the logger path so logging continues to stderr.
_resetForTests is exported only to isolate cached stream and environment-sensitive state in tests.
